claim_limits: Descriptive arithmetic of this fixed exposed historical archive only; no physical accuracy or latent-truth assertion.
Stored reference equality is checked, not assumed; repeated labels and material/model IDs are not independent experiments.
Actual reference choice UNKNOWN; no binder/preference execution, candidate-value match or preferred-reference reconstruction.
NOT_ADMITTED for scientific screening/uncertainty; no model winner, ranking, pass/fail threshold, hypothesis test, sampling interval, default relative error or floating RMSE.
No new split, fit, allocation, training-independence claim or fresh holdout. This secondary census does not resolve G20/G21.
Unequal stored reference values do not identify a correct reference or prove binder corruption; equal stored values do not establish common physical truth.

estimand.cross_model_reference_equality: Exactly36 groups keyed by material, structure, property and literal unit, each retaining all4 original model IDs. Compare all stored reference rationals for exact equality; separately report token-spelling and citation-string equality. No majority/reference selection, imputation, common-truth or equal-geometry inference.
estimand.population: Exactly36 original material/model IDs and four named stored-property positions each;144 positions, no exclusions, filtering, inferred labels or adaptive denominator. Fixed position weight1 within each group.
estimand.provenance: Every position retains unit_id/material/structure/model_id/source_path/declared_inputs_sha256, property ordinal, original prediction/reference tokens and citation in the private census; original43locations/172candidateedges remain unselected context through exact frame binding.
estimand.sign: signed_error = stored prediction value minus stored reference_value, both interpreted as exact serialized JSON decimal rationals.
estimand.summaries: Exactly16 groups keyed by original model_id, property and literal unit; each has9 fixed material positions. Report count, exact sums and exact arithmetic means of signed/absolute/squared errors. No all-model, cross-property, all-facet or incompatible-unit pooling.
estimand.unit_labels: signed/absolute summaries use literal original unit (J/m^2 or eV); squared summaries explicitly use (J/m^2)^2 or eV^2.

exact_arithmetic.representation: Reduced rational numerator/positive-denominator decimal strings. Preserve original signed-zero token spelling in provenance even though rational zero canonicalizes to0/1. Bounded chunked integer serialization handles worst-case squared-error numerators without float or process-global digit-limit overrides.
exact_arithmetic.token_semantics: Same strict JSON token grammar and exact sign*integer_mantissa*10^(explicit_exponent-fractional_digits) semantics as held recorded-label reader. No float conversion or global integer-string-limit change.

inputs.projection: Only the already written private recorded-label projection; never original bound/run/reference objects. Pure fixtures use generated bytes with the same closed schema.

outputs.failure: First closed validation/arithmetic/read error stops; no partial numerical census returned/written. Retain partial byte/parse/validation/arithmetic exposure and later output failures separately. Completed private write remains disclosed if public write fails.
outputs.private_census: All144 exact position calculations and per-record original tokens/citations/provenance remain private. No individual stored labels or individual discrepancies are published by the public output.
outputs.public_receipt: After a separately root-bound execution and review, publishable descriptive result includes the16 fixed model/property/unit group counts, exact signed/absolute/squared discrepancy sums and means, plus36 material/property stored-reference equality statuses. It also carries closed completion/progress/input-output identities. No per-record raw prediction/reference tokens, citations or individual discrepancies, arbitrary exception text, ranking or winner.
outputs.terminology: Public numeric aggregates are labeled stored-label discrepancies, not physical error estimates. The signed algebra remains prediction minus stored reference. Squared units remain explicit. Publication requires root review; no adaptive allocation or model preference is inferred.

planned_one_use_wrapper.behavior: Verify held self/contract/public-frame/readiness identity before reservation; exclusive durable output reservation before private target access; one no-follow regular-file read bounded expectedsize+1, exact size/hash on same immutable bytes, no retries/fallback/network. Recheck source/public binding before output; preserve possible partial read/write and private-output exposure. Fixture file wrapper rejects known actual/private and raw-custody paths.
planned_one_use_wrapper.state: UNBOUND; root alone supplies exact private-projection size/hash and authorizes a later invocation. No actual manifest or invocation during development.

validation.frame: Exact public frame and readiness hashes before any projection-byte interpretation; reject missing/duplicate/extra IDs or properties, changed context/path/unit/ordinal types, noncomplete records or malformed projection schema. Order may vary; outputs use fixed frame/property order.
validation.pairs: Require exactly one record per position, public readiness complete states, exact literal units and nonempty citation. Revalidate serialized tokens; reject bools, nonfinite/non-JSON text, coercions, missing values, state/token disagreement and engineering-limit breach. Ordinals nonnegative bounded<=511 and distinct within each original object.
validation.private_schema: Closed original projection field sets; no unselected fields accepted. Declared input hashes checked as lowercase64hex strings only, never compared with an unopened companion.
validation.tolerance: Reconcile each projected tolerance category with pinned public readiness (allNULL in this fixed archive). NULL is retained separately and supplies no pass criterion, physical tolerance, discrepancy bound or uncertainty estimate. Generated mismatches fail closed.
